stories.headline: Jayden Higgins Goes Down for the Whole Season, and Houston's Second Chair Is Suddenly Free Land
stories.read: Bad news out of the joint practice with Vegas, pardner: Higgins ran a route in the money patch, came down wrong, and the ACL let go. He's done for 2026. That's a fella who caught 41 balls and six scores as a pup and was fixin' to line up across from Nico Collins all year, so scratch him clean off your board. Here's your strike, though: those throws don't vanish, they get redistributed. Jaylin Noel, Xavier Hutchinson and Tank Dell are all stakin' the same open claim now, and Nico Collins' cut of the throws just got fatter than a fall bear. Go grab the Texans wideout you believe in while the saloon's still readin' the wire.

stories.headline: Chuba Hubbard Pulls Up Lame in Charlotte, and Jonathon Brooks Grabs the Reins
stories.read: Dave Canales came right out and called it a legit hamstring, put Hubbard week-to-week, and sat him for the Bills tune-up. The coach says he'll be good for game one, and coaches always say that. Meantime Jonathon Brooks is takin' first-team handoffs with Trevor Etienne and AJ Dillon mixin' in, and a hamstring on a back is the kind of thing that lingers like a bad debt. Knock Hubbard down a round from where the herd's grabbin' him, then go stake Brooks in the late rounds. That's the spare horse you keep saddled, and this one might just be runnin' the wagon by Week 2.

stories.headline: Sunday at Six the Herd Gets Thinned: 1,184 Fellas Hit the Open Range
stories.read: Every outfit in the league has to cut from ninety down to fifty-three by Sunday 6 p.m. Eastern, and that means better than eleven hundred men lose their saddle in about forty-eight hours. Arizona already turned Trey Benson loose and New England shipped Kayshon Boutte out the door, so the wagons are already rollin'. This is the single best day of the year to find cheap gold, pardner: a young back or wideout who was buried on one ranch's pecking order lands somewhere he's suddenly second in line. Don't draft blind before Sunday if you can help it, and when the dust settles Monday, be the first fella at the claims office.
